WITH days AS (
  SELECT calendar_date, fiscal_year, fiscal_week FROM dim_date
  WHERE fiscal_period = 2 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2026/27')
),
sales AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(f.net_amount) AS gross_of_returns
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN days d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
refunds AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(r.refund_net) AS refunds
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  JOIN days d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
net AS (
  SELECT s.fiscal_year, s.fiscal_week, s.gross_of_returns - COALESCE(r.refunds, 0) AS net_sales
  FROM sales s LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (fiscal_year, fiscal_week)
)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, t.fiscal_week,
       ROUND(t.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_this_year,
       ROUND(l.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (t.net_sales / l.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM net t JOIN net l ON l.fiscal_week = t.fiscal_week AND l.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
WHERE t.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
ORDER BY t.fiscal_week
